field.name: registration_layout_custom
field.label: Custom Layout
field.description:
Supply custom substitution and content plugin supported HTML layout to display. The HTML supplied will already been enclosed in the registration form element so do not include a form element here. This includes support for the following additional substitutions: [title] (renders registration page title), [canvas] (renders registration canvas url), [header] (renders registration page header message), [footer] (renders registration page footer message), [navigation] (renders all collected tab navigation), [tabs] (renders all tab content with tab navigation), [content] (renders all tab content), [title_TAB_ID] (renders tab title based off tab id), [content_TAB_ID] (renders tab contents based off tab id), [tab_TAB_ID] (renders tab contents based off tab id with tab navigation), [legend] (renders legend icons), and [button_submit] (renders form submit button).

Notice: This is purely visual. It will not affect form validation. If you fail to include fields that have been marked required the registration save will fail due to missing required field.
